title: Aircraft must be supplied and exist
why: Shows that the aircraft reference is validated for both empty and dangling values.

steps.does: POST …/flight twice with otherwise valid data: first with AircraftId 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, then with AircraftId 7c9e6679-7425-40de-944b-e07fc1f90ae7 (no such Aircraft)

expect: Both rejected with a validation or not-found error naming AircraftId; no Flight is created.
